record_title: A single nilpotent strictly singular operator witnesses the sharp compactness exponent
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Shift-like constructions for non-compact powers of strictly singular operators are established prior art in other spaces; the claimed contribution is the sharp single-operator realization for the Laustsen--Wirzenius Baernstein/Schreier/ell_p direct sums. No independent validation is asserted.
